name: io.github.EzkielynaGroup/mcp-bmkg
title: BMKG Gempa & Cuaca
description: Indonesian earthquakes and village weather forecasts from BMKG open data. No API key.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BMKG_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout per BMKG request in ms (default 10000)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BMKG_CACHE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Cache lifetime per URL in ms (default 60000)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BMKG_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override base URL for both BMKG hosts (tests or mirrors)
